from datetime import datetime

class User:
    user_id = user_id
    username = username
    email = email
    created_at: datetime = datetime.utcnow()
    -_is_active = True
    -_is_active = False
    __init__(self, user_id: int, username: str, email: str)
    deactivate(self) -> None
    get_status(self) -> str
    __repr__(self) -> str
</file>
